In honor of America’s semiquincentennial, E Pluribus Unum: Celebrating the American Experience will explore all the different areas of our culture that are distinctly American. From music, food, art, recreation, to symbols of our nation, this exhibit will inspire visitors with a sense of the important facets that unite our blended culture into something greater than the sum of our parts.
